claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine
claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera powered on or taking a picture; only the physical body is visible.

claims.claim: I am selling with 2 batteries and a silicone case
claims.evidence: Neither batteries nor a silicone case appear in Photo 0 or Photo 1.
Nikon branding is visible on the camera top and on the box in Photos 0 and 1.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or function correctly.
risks.proof: Video of the camera turning on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working body for parts or repair.

risks.risk: Shutter count or actuator wear is unknown.
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo of the shutter count from the camera menu or a connected computer.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming average-to-high shutter wear for a used D7100.

risks.risk: Sensor has dust, scratches, or dead pixels.
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with the mirror locked up, or a test shot of a plain white surface at a small aperture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the sensor may need cleaning or repair.

risks.risk: Buttons, dials, or autofocus system are faulty.
risks.proof: Video showing all dials and buttons responding and autofocus acquiring focus in live view and through the viewfinder.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if controls or autofocus may not work.

risks.risk: Batteries and charger are missing, dead, or counterfeit.
risks.proof: Photo or video of two batteries and a charger, with the camera running on battery power.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without any battery or charger.

risks.risk: Memory card slot or other ports (USB, HDMI) do not work.
risks.proof: Video of a memory card being read and a cable connected to USB or HDMI.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if ports and slots may be non-functional.

risks.risk: Camera has a hidden history of drops, repairs, or water damage.
risks.proof: Detailed photos of the body for dents or corrosion and seller disclosure of any repair history.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it may have undisclosed damage or repairs.

risks.risk: No original warranty or purchase receipt.
risks.proof: Photo of the original receipt or warranty documents.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with no warranty and no proof of purchase.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, taking a photo, and reviewing the image.
Photo or screenshot of the shutter count.
Photo of the sensor with mirror locked up.
Video demonstrating buttons, dials, and autofocus.
Photo or video of two batteries, charger, and silicone case.
Photo of any receipt or warranty documents.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon D7100 body from visible markings in both photos, so the item can be priced at its worst case as a used body; unproven functions and accessories can be added with evidence.
